verdict.rationale: Editor language-service support is a fair question for a TypeScript UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents an Angular language service or editor integration. The only autocompletion item (angular-docs-26) covers CLI command completion in the terminal, which is an adjacent feature. General TypeScript praise reflects the host language, not an Angular editor capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate autocompletion and inline type errors in my editor via a language service integration
